messages:
taylor_g: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing a recurring kv-eviction pattern under sustained P95 load. want to turn the postmortem actions into concrete test/eval additions so we stop shipping regressions. proposed buckets: regression CI entry, nightly load test ramp, incident-driven promptset for evals, and a quarterly chaos drill. owners + timelines below. comments?
maria_ops: ack. love the buckets. can we scope them as: 1) CI regression (fast, synthetic), 2) nightly long-run load (budgeted), 3) evaluator promptset (covers worst-case prompts), 4) chaos drill (runbook validation).
devon_ml: I can own the promptset + eval harness work. plan: build promptset that reproduces degradation patterns and wire it into nightly evals. ETA: 2 sprints. creating RINF-2456 now.
raj_platform: I can take load tests + CI regression. need a checklist for infra sizing and cost cap. I'll spin up a k6-based workload and a synthetic KV-noise generator. creating RINF-2471.
taylor_g: assigning as above. please add tasks to the postmortem board and tag with label "postmortem-eval". proposed soft deadlines: CI regression PR by 2024-12-05, nightly load integrated by 2025-01-10, chaos drill schedule and runbook ready by 2025-01-20.
maria_ops: quick q — what's the minimal promptset scope to be useful? do we capture: a) long-context token churn that stresses KV size, b) prefix-heavy conversational patterns that force cache eviction, c) multi-tenant spike scenarios?
devon_ml: yes to those. sample promptset snippet I'll start with: 
```
# promptset example (short descriptors, actual prompts stored in repo)
PROMPT_001: "multi-turn convo, 12k context, repeated references to earlier turns to force KV hit patterns"
PROMPT_002: "rapid-fire short queries from 100 concurrent simulated users hitting same conversation id"
METRIC: token-flip-rate, alignment-drop, latency-p95
```
I'll add automated checks that flag >5% quality regression vs baseline.
raj_platform: for the load test: plan is k6 -> k8s job with noise generator. ramp 10 -> 200 virtual users over 15m, sustain for 2h, repeat 3x. script will exercise both hosted route and dedicated pools to validate smart routing fallbacks. budget estimate in RINF-2471.
taylor_g: also add a small canary step to the CI regression that injects limited KV eviction via fault injection so we don't just test happy paths.
maria_ops: scheduling a 30m sync to align owners and unblock infra creds: Tue 10:00 PT. invite to: @devon_ml @raj_platform @taylor_g @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Incident-driven testing sync" Tue 10:00 PT — link: https://calendar.redwood/incident-testing-sync
devon_ml: will draft PR template for promptset additions and example eval thresholds. putting target eval thresholds in RINF-2456: no >5% regression on rouge/qual proxies, latency p95 increase <= 15% under worst-case baseline.
taylor_g: perfect. if owners hit infra or permission blockers, escalate to eng-sre and cc me. closing action items summary in this thread: RINF-2456 (promptset + eval harness) RINF-2471 (load + CI regression) RINF-2472 (chaos drill + runbook). please update tickets when PRs open.
maria_ops: thanks all :thumbsup:
